terms.comment: Our description: a preparation containing several vitamins. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have the vitamin (see vitamin) but no multivitamin. Praeparātum as a noun is the pharmacists’ modern word (M-O s.v. chemical, from the Austrian pharmacopoeia); Lewis & Short has only the participle.

sources: Morgan–Owens: Adumbratio · Vitaminum: Calepinus Novus attribution
